assets.title: Create a polished, professional vis Visual
assets.description:
A breathtaking, high-end editorial photography showcasing Create a polished, professional visual representation of my software project.

Show a modern computer screen displaying the project's interface clearly and realistically. The UI should look like a real, fully developed application rather than a generic template.

Focus on:

* Clean and modern UI design
* Professional spacing and alignment
* Consistent typography
* Intuitive navigation
* Well-designed buttons, cards, forms, and menus
* Responsive-looking layout
* Realistic dashboard elements
* Clear visual hierarchy
* Subtle shadows and depth
* Modern minimalist aesthetic
* High-quality realistic screen rendering

The interface should look production-ready, sophisticated, and visually consistent.

Use a clean background with subtle lighting. Keep the image uncluttered and ensure the application's main interface is the visual focus.

Do not add random text, fake logos, watermarks, unnecessary icons, distorted UI elements, or unrelated objects.

Ultra-detailed, realistic UI mockup, professional product presentation, sharp screen details, balanced composition, premium modern software aesthetic, high resolution, 16:9 aspect ratio.
, cinematic studio lighting, elegant textures, clean aesthetic, 8k resolution visual art without any written words.
